M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.eShunt_specific_novel_angle: eShunt drains to venous sinus. During sleep apnea, venous congestion raises venous sinus pressure 5-15 mmHg, reducing CSF-venous pressure differential (the eShunt's driving pressure). Patient-specific calibration of sleep-state venous pressure profile + adaptive drainage compensating for sleep-state venous pressure changes is eShunt-specific physiology NOT present in VP shunts (which drain to peritoneum, where sleep-state venous pressure is irrelevant).
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.summary: M5 has partial saturation from VIEshunt (2025) for posture-specific ICP references. The eShunt-specific novel angle — patient-specific calibration of sleep-state venous pressure profile + adaptive drainage compensating for sleep apnea-induced venous congestion — is NOT directly taught. CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL; requires V2 passage-level VIEshunt audit.

honest_negative_findings: M3 (programmable patient-specific opening pressure) is DESTROYED_BY_PRIOR_ART — foundational Hakim patent US4551128A and Cordis adjustable-valve family saturate this mechanism.

M2 (posture-adaptive gravity valve) is SATURATED by gravitational anti-siphon valve patents (US9731102B2 DePuy Synthes, US7922685B2 Codman) and VIEshunt 2025 posture-specific ICP references. eShunt-specific clinical need is REDUCED because eShunt drains to venous sinus (shorter hydrostatic column than head-to-peritoneum).

M1 (patient-specific sizing via imaging) is WEAK_NOVEL — patient-specific sizing of vascular implants is standard-of-care (TAVR, stent grafts). eShunt-specific sizing is routine engineering adaptation.
M7 (custom curved distal tip) is WEAK_NOVEL — routine engineering adaptation; CereVasc's own catheter patents describe navigating venous anatomy.

M4 (CSF production-rate matching) has near-direct hits on production-rate measurement/regulation (US8109899B2 Likvor, US11173289B2 CSF Refresh). Combined pressure+flow sensor in shunt also patented (CA2653898C Codman). Production rate measurement impractical for routine clinical use (requires MRI phase-contrast).

M8 (closed-loop non-invasive ICP proxy) has 5+ direct hits on non-invasive ICP monitoring side (Cerebrotech, Wolf, MIT, Third Eye, Augusta). Closed-loop integration with shunt adjustment may be novel but §103 risk is HIGH.
